levelNote: Electronic signatures are admissible in evidence and can satisfy a signature requirement for most contracts.

formRequirements.note: Wills need a witnessed handwritten signature under the Wills Act 1837.
A deed needs a witness who is physically present when it is signed.

notices: Electronic signature law that applies: Electronic Communications Act 2000 and UK eIDAS. Electronic signatures are admissible in evidence and can satisfy a signature requirement for most contracts.
You must be at least 18 years old to sign this agreement.
If you are unsure whether this applies to you, ask for a paper alternative before signing.
limitationNote: Simple contracts: six years; deeds: twelve (Limitation Act 1980).
